files.rationale: Drops the direct @epic-web/workshop-app dependency as PR B intends (none of PR A's new CLI modules import it) while keeping PR A's added @epic-web/invariant, openid-client and zod dependencies.

Uses PR B's async, prioritized findWorkshopAppDir (env var, --app-location flag, Node resolution, global lookup, monorepo fallback) and node: imports alongside PR A's tool/resource/prompt commands, keeping a single supportedKeys declaration at PR A's position to avoid a duplicate const.
